title: Water-Soluble Vitamin Excess
subtitle: Evidence, dosing, safety, interactions, and practical considerations for water-soluble vitamin excess.
evidence_strength: Established evidence for acute toxicity of vitamin B6 and niacin; moderate evidence for vitamin C-related adverse effects; emerging evidence for long-term outcomes of chronic excess; clinical guidelines based on observational and experimental data.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
